column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Moze's Genesis War Revelation
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: W-what is this enormous ruined city?!
This is the remnant of a continent once...
created by $$ゴッド$$, whom all people revered as divine,
called the $$エデンの園$$!
Even in this $$世界$$, where there is no land beyond where we just were,
there were once many continents and animals...
and descendants of the $$サル$$s named $$アダム$$ and $$イブ$$ lived here, it is said!!
At the time, many $$大天使$$s, living separately in white Heaven and black Earth...
watched these $$サル達$$ grow with kind eyes...
Above all, the compassionate $$大天使$$ $$メフィスト$$, whom we revere as our $$救世主$$...
was especially fond of these $$サル達$$...
$$ゴッド$$ once
created a pitiful $$メスザル$$ as $$アダム$$'s first wife, then cast her aside...
and I hear he took her as one of his own wives...
And then $$メフィスト$$
pitied those $$サル達$$—always naked, with no $$羽$$ at all...
and gave them the $$知恵の実$$ in Heaven!!
“God made these $$サル達$$ in His own image, I hear...
And yet why should God say they must not be given wisdom?!”
“I think...
therefore I am...
Surely the wisdom needed to know ourselves
is the essence that makes us who we are... is it not?!”
$$大神ゴッド$$ was enraged by this!!
And, in a fit of rage, He assailed the $$エデンの園$$ with torrential rains and a great flood...
and is said to have buried everything beneath this sea...
Hard as it is to believe,
that huge ark in $$隷属の地ノア$$, too...
is said to have been built on the command of the $$大天使$$ $$ラファエル$$, who first noticed this calamity,
to evacuate the animals on the surface,
ordering an $$サル$$ named $$ノア$$ to build it!
Th-that's insane!
First of all, how could an $$サル$$ build a ship...?!
That is what I told you!
Those $$サル達$$ had been given wisdom...
Indeed, the $$創世記戦争$$ that split Heaven in two began because
$$メフィスト$$ was enraged by this outrageous treatment at $$ゴッド$$'s hands...
and began it with $$大天使$$s who shared his convictions, it is said...
That is proven by these $$石板$$s and hidden passageways, too: they were excavated from those ruins.
*Cough!* *Hack!*
Sir $$モーゼ$$!!
It seems... I can accompany you no further...
It appears this is as far as I go.
Your body—what happened to it?!
It seems our present $$大善神$$, $$ハ・サタン$$, whom we revere,
seems especially fond of $$血$$ $$生贄$$s... *cough!*
To pass through the $$冥界の門$$ ahead, one must possess both black and white $$羽$$s and two hearts, like the $$教皇$$—
that is, only one who holds within their body the powers of both God and an $$邪神$$—
is said to be able to open the $$封印$$ed door leading to the $$約束の地$$.
Who the hell has power like that?!
It is you!!
The $$大邪神$$ armor you wear holds both powers: destruction and creation.
Therefore, you are the one who should possess that power!
I agree.
Come, raise this $$石板$$ before the gate.
There's no turning back now. It's not like we've got another choice, right?!
No harm in trying. Let's give it a shot!
I'm kind of excited!!
You alone can handle that $$石板$$ now!
Please do your best!!
I shall record every last word of this day in my $$日記$$.
I have waited for the day I could entrust this $$石板$$.
My name is $$モーゼ$$, guardian of the $$石板$$s.
I entrust this power to the one who will lead this $$世界$$ into a new commandment!!
I am one who truly desires an equal $$世界$$!!!
“Gate Opening Movie”
One who inherits Lord $$ハ・サタン$$'s true will appears...
It is time for the $$世界$$... to be transformed.
I too have finally... fulfilled my duty.
Sir $$モーゼ$$!
Looks like we've been forced onto a road with no way back!
We cannot dawdle!!
After that spectacle, there will be enemies waiting in droves beyond the gate!
It may sound trite, but...
“If you do not enter the tiger's den, you cannot catch its cub,” huh?
Here they come already!
They are angels who died in the gods' war, their restless spirits transformed into zombies...
$$ゾンビエンジェル$$!
This is, in a manner of speaking, a $$血$$stained passage leading to hell.
We break through at once!
